rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reading burden for verification = banned

rules_evaluated.evidence: prework.md step 5 has Claude 'confirm the repo can test, branch, commit, and open a PR', and the module closes on 'Close the prework session when Claude confirms readiness' — no instruction to verify the readiness claim at the artifact (actual command output) before closing. Harm per §31(a): self-report inflation means a phase can end on a claim rather than a checked fact; mitigated but not eliminated by the fact that tool-call output is visible in-transcript by default.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: add a light verify-at-artifact move (e.g. 'check the test command actually ran') before the session closes, per §31(a).
